summary: Iteration 2: verified new features — functional contact email POST, ES/EN i18n toggle w/ localStorage persistence, expanded product brand chips (all 4 categories), and new Aliados section (partners strip + 3 testimonials). Backend 6/6 tests pass. Frontend all flows pass. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero headline uses per-character span animation, so raw substring searches on innerText may not match; not a bug — just a testability note. Consider aria-label on the H1 for a stable accessible name.

OWNER_EMAIL is intentionally set to delivered@resend.dev per problem statement (external proxy blocks admin@ferinfectedcorp.com.mx). Main agent should confirm production plan for DNS/domain verification before switching.
seed_data_creation: None (contact endpoint intentionally does not persist to Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contact tests: POST /api/contact returns 200 with {status:'success', email_id:<uuid>} (verified real email_id e.g. 01a0d02b-4bca-...). Invalid/empty payloads correctly return 422. Frontend: lang-toggle-desktop toggles ES↔EN (hero copy, nav labels HOME/SERVICES/PRODUCTS/ABOUT/PARTNERS/CONTACT), persists in localStorage as 'fic_lang'. Productos: product-item-{celulares,consolas,laptops,tvs} clicks update active spotlight and render product-brands-<id> chips (iPhone 15 Pro Max, PlayStation 5 Slim, MacBook Pro M3, LG OLED evo G4 all verified). Aliados: partners-strip contains Apple/Samsung/Sony/LG/… and testimonial-0/1/2 render. Contact form: empty submit → error toast 'Completa tu nombre y correo para continuar.'; valid submit → button flips to 'ENVIANDO…' then success toast '¡Gracias! Tu solicitud fue enviada. Te contactaremos pronto.'. Lenis smooth-scroll active (__lenis=true), body scrollHeight ~6804px. Zero console errors.
